notes.title: Update 2.1 - Mobile Release with Cross-Platform Saves Support!
notes.content:
[h1]Get the game at the mobile stores[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Android:[/b] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.AOGames.IdleFishing
[*][b]iOS:[/b] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/idle-fishing-mobile/id6614782311
[/list]
- Use a cloud account to effortlessly sync your save across all devices.

[h2]New Free Codes![/h2]
[list]
[*]Mobile - 200 Gems - Can be only used on Android/iOS.
[*]KentCity - for his help with the game - 10 Medals
[/list]
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]There will be a star next to the best zone each day, so it will be easier to tell what is the best zone for today.
[*]Added FPS Counter option to the settings under the "Video" Tab
[*]You will be able to choose the FPS counter position - for example: Top Middle, Top Left, Bottom Right, and so on.
[*][Mobile] You will get away income if the application was unfocused for more than 3 minutes, so even if you don't close the game, the away income will work as intended.
[*]Added "Recover from backup" to the panel you see when your save is corrupted(due to power outages and stuff like that), no need to manually recover from backups anymore.
[*][Mobile] Option to watch an ad to get extra away income, even if you don't instantly watch the ad, you will be offered to do it later for few minutes.
[*][Mobile] Claim the daily rewards from the premium shop multiple times by watching ads, for example get more gems/other currency per day by watching ads.
[*]Made the fishing line more transparent
[*]New setting to show/hide fishing lines
[*]Many more things that I didn't write down, mostly new things to make the mobile experience better.
[/list]

[h2]Changed/Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Massive performance boost for Steam and Mobile versions
[*]Catch X Common Fish daily quests will no longer be offered after the first rebirth.
[*]Did it because after the first rebirth your chances of catching common fish is very low, so it takes long time to finish.
[*]Many small things that I didn't write down, but nothing major.
[/list]

[h2]Planned Next Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Update 2.2[/b] - New System - Excavation with an Upgrade Shop!
[*][b]Update 2.3[/b] - Quality of life - you can still suggest them on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/YbB4HhJzFv]Discord[/url] or [b]Steam Forums[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Cross-Platform Saves with New Account System
notes.content:
Hey! in preparation for the Mobile versions, I've added a Cloud Accounts system to the game, so it will sync between your PC and phone effortlessly.
[list][*]Your created account will be used for all future games as well![/list]
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cloud Account System
[list]
[*]Auto syncs your saves between devices.
[*]Ability to link your Steam account to it, so you can login with 1 click.[/list]
[*]I've split the UI audio layer to 2 types
[list]
[*]General UI [*]mostly sounds on click
[*]Notifications [*]notification sounds like "Finished daily quest", "Finished holiday task"[/list]
[*]More parts of the game is translatable now, like the timers of "5d 2h 25m until next reset"[/list]

[h2]Changed/Fixed[/h2][list]
[*]Now if you have the Rebirth upgrade get only 3+ Star pets, the egg opening animation will start from only 3 stars to avoid confusion. 
[*]Tapping seagulls on touch screen devices now works.
[*]The in-game auto clicker function was removed from the premium store.
[*]Many small things that I didn't write down, but nothing major.[/list]

[h2]Planned Next Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Update 2.1[/b] - Mobile Update(Android + IOS) with cross platform save support.
[*][b]Update 2.2[/b] - New system & content - will be revealed soon.
[*][b]Update 2.3[/b] - Quality of life - you can still suggest them on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/YbB4HhJzFv]Discord[/url] or [b]Steam Forums[/b].

notes.title: Update 1.9.1 - Performance Optimizations, Christmas Gifts, Improved Graphics
notes.content:

[*]Christmas Codes!
[list]

[/h1]
[b]After a lot of hard work, the game is finally ready for release, I hope you'll enjoy it!
[/b]
I plan to do weekly content updates in the coming months.
[h1]Current Planned Updates:
[/h1][list]
[*][b]Fishing Contests[/b] - You will earn new currency, medals.
[*][b]Medal Shop[/b] - You'll be able to spend there your medals, buying useful upgrades.
[*][b]Pets[/b] - Hatch, breed and upgrade pets that will hang out at your boat, and will give you awesome bonuses.
[/list]
If you want to suggest an update, let me know in the [url=https://discord.gg/4tsRt54nRQ]Discord[/url]
